decisions.reason: Design reviewed: 4 testable acceptance criteria incl. negative auth cases, test-first task plan, additive endpoint with no change to existing behavior. Approved to apply in isolated workspace.
Tests red then green (64 passed, 0 failed), threat review has no open high threats, all policy checks passed, docs updated. Release approved.

limitations: metrics are demonstration data from a single workstation

plan_and_rationale.approach: Add GET /api/v1/links/{code}: link details (destination, created_at, expires_at, active) for the creating API key; other keys get 404.

trade_offs: deterministic rule-based agents apply human-locked change sets instead of generating code at run time
scenario runs evaluate SEC-003 against a pinned pip-audit snapshot (no network); the live audit runs in `orch release check`
releases are local (snapshot or local staging); merging into the repository stays a manual human action
why: all stages succeeded and every gate was decided by a human (approve-design by approver key 63320c4d1c94; approve-release by release-owner key 2788b911e283)
